parameters.first: The panel at the start (or the top).
parameters.second: The panel at the end (or the bottom).
parameters.axis: Side by side, or one over the other.
parameters.initialFraction: The first panel's share at the start.
parameters.minSecond: The minimum extent of the second pane.
parameters.onChanged: Called with the first panel's share as it moves.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Whether the knob takes focus when it first shows.
parameters.minFirst: The minimum extent of the first pane.
